case_brief.what_it_is: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is an employment-linked incentive scheme launched by the Government of India to incentivize job creation. It offers direct financial incentives to first-time formal employees and financial support to employers expanding their workforce. The scheme covers eligible jobs created between August 1, 2025, and July 31, 2027.
case_brief.entitlement: First-time employees registered with EPFO with salaries up to Rs 1 lakh per month receive a one-month EPF wage incentive up to Rs 15,000, transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) using the Aadhaar Bridge Payment System. The incentive is paid in two installments: the 1st installment after 6 months of service, and the 2nd installment after 12 months of service and completion of a financial lite… (+106 chars)
conditions: The employee must be a first-time worker registered with EPFO.
The job must be created between August 1, 2025, and July 31, 2027.
The employee's salary/wage must not exceed Rs 1,000,000 (Rs 1 lakh) per month.
The employee must complete 6 months of continuous service to receive the 1st installment.
The employee must complete 12 months of continuous service to receive the 2nd installment.
The employee must complete a mandatory financial literacy programme before the 2nd installment is released.
common_failure_reasons: Service duration is less than 6 months for the first installment or less than 12 months for the second installment.
Failure or non-completion of the required financial literacy programme before claiming the second installment.
Employee's monthly salary exceeds Rs 1 lakh.
Employment started prior to August 1, 2025, or after July 31, 2027.
case_brief.official_grievance_channel: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) / Ministry of Labour & Employment
documents_needed: Aadhaar card linked to bank account (for Aadhaar Bridge Payment System)
